matchupOfTheWeek.title: Pass Defense vs. Pass Offense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our pass defense grades 90/100 (among the NFL's best) against LV's pass offense at 68/100 (above average) — the widest statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here's the thing about Sunday's matchup: our pass defense is genuinely elite at 90/100, and we're throwing it at an above-average Raiders pass offense graded at 68/100—that's the widest statistical edge on the board this week, and it's ours. The problem is our cornerstone secondary is decimated. We're missing starting CBs Christian Gonzalez and Carlton Davis, which means we're about to ask a patched-together secondary to execute the game plan of its life against Kirk Cousins, who's been one of the NFL's biggest surprises this season. And then there's the other side of the ball: our run defense grades 23/100 (one of the league's worst), while Las Vegas's rush offense is somehow worse at 3/100, so maybe that's our one gift. The line says we're favored by 3.5, and we've somehow managed just one win in our last four meetings against these guys, so expect this to come down to whether our pass defense can stay brilliant when half our best players are on crutches.
